_header: Preset qwen36-q6_k-vision (base + images, UD-Q6_K, no MTP). Copy next to your install. 5 EDITS, every path absolute:
1. "exe": your engine exe (engine-hyper\hyper.exe inside your install folder).
2. "args" "--model": your base UD-Q6_K .gguf file. Keep "--max-context" 131072, "--kv" q4_0, "--no-draft" (no "--draft-kv").
3. "vision" "mmproj": your mmproj-Q8_0 file for pictures; "vision" "model" must match "--model"; "gpu" stays false (CPU encoder).
4. "cwd" + "tokenizer" + "log": your install folder, packs-dir tokenizer, and log path.
Start it with run-qwen36-q6_k-vision.bat. Proof it runs: http://127.0.0.1:8080/health says loaded:true.
